# Dekel Nissim

> Product Designer & UX Researcher. Partners with startups, enterprises, and public-sector teams to turn messy problems into clear, human-centered products, backed by research rather than opinion.

Services: UX research, product design, design systems, and product strategy. Contact: dklnsm@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/): Overview, selected case studies, and client testimonials.
- [About](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/about): Background, services, and the four-step Understand / Define / Design / Deliver process.
- [Articles](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/articles): Essays on product, UX, and AI, each published in English and Hebrew.
- [Business Card](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/business-card): Freelance one-pager with a contact form.

## Case studies

- [Salary Additions](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/salaries): End-to-end internal system automating salary calculations and approvals, including a custom algorithm.
- [Marketer](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/marketer): Design system built as the first product designer at a marketing-management startup.
- [Myco](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/myco): Marketing management system and producers interface, designed end to end.
- [Employee Onboarding Page](https://dkl-portfolio.herokuapp.com/employees): Onboarding experience that helps new employees ramp up faster.

## Notes

- The site is a client-rendered single-page app; content is rendered by JavaScript.
- Articles are available in English and Hebrew via a language toggle on the page.
- There is no public API. The only backend endpoint is the contact form submission.
